decisions.proof: For every shared valid base, the positive argument 2^p 3^q has logarithm p*u+q*v. The sixteen raw tuples omit exactly (1/2,1), leaving twelve integer-power and three square-root tuples. Negative exponents represent reciprocals; all current canonical pairs and Teach (1,2) are excluded.
decisions.scope_and_pedagogy: Accept: named-log expression, products, reciprocals and fractional power branch, valid shared-base assumptions, exact symbolic contract. Supplied prime factors scaffold application of the canonical log rules. The first rung remains useful for other canonical targets needing factorization.

decisions.proof: Exact evaluation of every raw tuple admits exactly twelve: N(N-pq)(N+pq)=0 and positive p,q imply cosine N/(2pq) is -1/2,0,1/2. p<q and positivity imply q+r>p; the other two strict triangle inequalities are explicit.
